figures.public_caption: Figure 1. Visual representations of site-controlled nanowire quantum dots. (a) A scanning electron micrograph of a single nanowire grown on a patterned SiO2 substrate using selective area MOCVD. The inset shows a nanowire array with 2 μm spacing. (b) A transmission electron micrograph showing a single quantum dot near the tip of a nanowire. (c) A schematic diagram of a nanowire with a single quantum dot.
